title: No limit on the number of shops a person owns
decision: The limit of five shops a person is removed. One trial a person and every later shop starting in limited mode until paid stay as in DEC-061, as do the rate limits on opening shops. The same limit is removed from reassigning ownership (DEC-062). The daily cap that security finding 13 suggested is not built
context: Answered by the founder on 2026-10-08 when asked by the agent in the working session
chosen_option: No limit; later shops start limited
rationale: The founder was asked and chose no limit with later shops limited, over five shops, one shop, or a trial for each shop. Owners of several outlets need no second account, and a trial cannot be taken twice
